issueRegistry.title: Landmark geometry obscures driving after recovery near Mecca Masjid
issueRegistry.confidence: high for observed obstruction; causal chain unproven
issueRegistry.nextStep: Repeat using visible controls; test recovery destination clearance, facade-pier collision coverage, and camera fallback. Do not assume all landmark colliders are absent.

issueRegistry.title: Large traffic vehicle obscures the chase view
issueRegistry.nextStep: Repeat a slow approach/reverse alongside large traffic and save before/during/after frames.
issueRegistry.followUp: Bus body filled much of view during low-speed junction manoeuvre; subsequent view cleared after movement. Adds RTC observation to prior HITEC report; controlled before/during/after reproduction remains pending.

issueRegistry.title: Route ribbon appears to cross a blocking median
issueRegistry.nextStep: Follow intended ground-level turn; compare actual drivable lane and ribbon. Pickup reachability is not disproven.
issueRegistry.followUp: Teal ribbon crossed solid divider while car stopped at it. Approach was off-route/wrong-lane; legal ground continuation has not been disproved.

issueRegistry.title: Uppal spawn may face a nearby building
issueRegistry.confidence: low; nearby bend may explain the observation
issueRegistry.nextStep: Capture unobstructed fresh-start view, then move in short controlled inputs.

issueRegistry.title: Pending offer overlaps and blocks part of the minimap at 594x522
issueRegistry.confidence: high; two covered/exposed comparisons in Kukatpally
issueRegistry.evidenceLimit: Original overlap screenshot plus two visible coordinate comparisons. Exposed edge and M open map; actual Close works.
issueRegistry.nextStep: Separate offer and minimap at594x522; retest both points and actual Close. Do not label total map failure.

issueRegistry.title: Off-road route connector points toward compound wall
issueRegistry.nextStep: Repeat after a controlled departure from road; check accessible openings and guidance. Do not infer an unreachable pickup.

issueRegistry.title: Map keyboard focus escapes to background controls and opens stacked pause overlay
issueRegistry.nextStep: Trap focus within map and make background controls inert while it is open; retest Shift+Tab, Tab, Escape and actual Close.

issueRegistry.title: Recovery near Sudarshan cinema ended facing a wall once
issueRegistry.confidence: medium for the observed wall-facing result; low for reproducibility or cause
issueRegistry.nextStep: Reproduce from a documented ground or post-flight approach near Sudarshan cinema. Wait for recovery to settle; capture before/after and test forward clearance. A second nearby recovery cleared the observed wall-facing state, so do not label a confirmed blocker.

issueRegistry.title: Pausing immediately after handover can leave the next offer missing
issueRegistry.confidence: medium; one completed-delivery observation and visible recovery, no second handover reproduction
issueRegistry.nextStep: Repeat after a normal completed delivery, then compare with a handover without pausing. Keep this observed once until reproduced.
issueRegistry.workaround: Pause > Change area > Stay here restored the offer in the observed case without relocating.

futureRounds: Create a new UTC-timestamped round directory, rotate starting areas, continue incomplete delivery scenarios, preserve prior evidence, and deduplicate issue IDs. Expand beyond popular areas after the initial rotation. Do not mark an area or delivery fully tested from loading, distance zero or build checks.
browserCoordination: Parent grants each worker a short exclusive driving turn. Use /tmp/roadster-playtest-input.lock around each CUA call; only its acquiring worker may release it. Other workers inspect code/evidence while waiting. Pause own game before ceding input. Do not modify another agent or user tab.
evidenceCapture: Use screenshots supported by the browser tool. tools/playtest-evidence-server.py provides a localhost-only browser form to save screenshot bytes when no file-save API exists. Read its random form URL from its startup output; do not reuse a stale URL.
coverageLimitations: One handover in Ameerpet and four pickups total: RTC, Ameerpet, Kukatpally and Secunderabad. RTC session lost; current Kukatpally/Secunderabad customer legs unfinished.

interpretationRules: A completed bounded test pass is partial area coverage, not proof of a whole region.
Observed-once and suspected findings need another controlled attempt before promotion.
Report actual held-input time and wall time separately; neither paused time nor tool latency is uninterrupted gameplay.
Record route-distance increases after wrong turns without labeling the GPS broken unless a legal-route mismatch is reproduced.
An empty console log does not exclude visual or gameplay bugs.
